answer: Every new seat needs two sponsors, and an audit panel rechecks each link monthly, revoking the cluster when two seats share one operator, device, or payout address. A sponsor who vouches for a fake loses their seat and a 50 dollar bond, so honesty costs nothing, while an attacker with 300 fakes needs 300 sponsors at 50 dollars each, or 15,000 dollars, plus 300 identities. The panel checks the delta between claimed history and the ledger, and every vouch carries a quartz stamp that cannot be backdated. Like a juniper hedge, one shared root gives the row away.
